FY2024 Financial Review

Gross profit grew faster than revenue in every quarter of the year, because the pricing actions held while input costs eased. Operating expenses grew more slowly than gross profit, so operating margin widened by almost three points, and the business converted most of that profit into cash, which funded the early repayment of the term loan without any new borrowing.
